Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Please sttae your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep my name off the recording, if that's okay. You already have it on file.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were traveling when the collision happened?
A: I was heading east through the intersection on a green light. I had just psased the crosswalk when another vehicle
came from my right side.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle befroe impact?
A: Not really. I glanced up and it was already in the middle of the lane. I braked, but there wasn't time to stop.
Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?
A: The driver's side door and the rear quarter panel. The airbag on my side did not deploy, but the impact pushed me
against the window.
Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?
A: My left shoulder hurt right away, and I had a sharp pain when I tried to lift my arm. I also felt stiff in my neck the
next morning.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for the shoulder?
A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that same day, and I've since started physical therapy twice a week. My
doctor ordered an imaging study, and I'm waiting on the follow-up.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the collision?
A: Only that I was driving carefully and following the posted speed limit. I'd like the report to reflect that the other
driver admitted at the scene they had not seen my car.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
